events.title: Reflexive Digital Ethnography of Nepali Digital Queer Culture Guided by Indigenous Research Methodologies
events.description:
15 November 2026/२९ कात्तिक २०८३ (आइतबार, दिउँसो ३ बजे)
Research Seminar Series
Reflexive Digital Ethnography of Nepali Digital Queer Culture Guided by Indigenous Research Methodologies
Shubha Kayastha, PhD Researcher, RMIT (Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology), Australia

Abstract
This presentation examines methodological and ethical issues in researching the online expression of young Nepali sexual and gender diverse (SGD) people and communities. It is based on the researcher's experiences—including, but not limited to, adopting, applying and eventually abandoning of digital content analysis as a data collection tool—for her doctoral research, while she is guided by her research participants. The presentation provides a reflexive account of the researcher’s privileges and limitations as an ‘insider-within’ researcher. It considers how the researcher negotiates the requirements and practices in Western academic institutions to avoid and resist deficit framing using Indigenous research methodologies. Through the reflexivity it was found that researchers are accountable in applying ethics of reciprocity and avoid reinforcing a colonial extractive practice while researching marginalised groups.

About the Speaker
Shubha Kayastha is a feminist activist who works in the intersection of gender, sexuality and technology. She is currently a PhD researcher at RMIT (Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology), studying the navigation of privacy and visibility by young Nepali sexual and gender diverse people in digital spaces. Shubha was the co-founder and former executive director of a digital rights organization, Body &amp; Data.

events.description:
चौतारी वार्षिक सम्मेलन - २०२६ का लागि स्वयंसेवक आवश्यकता सम्बन्धी सूचना

Registration Open for Chautari Annual Conference – 2026

List of Selected Abstracts

Call for Papers/Panels
Chautari Annual Conference – 2026
&nbsp;

Martin Chautari (MC) is organizing the Chautari Annual Conference in Kathmandu, Nepal on&nbsp;November 25–27, 2026. The aim of this conference is to promote research culture in the humanities and social sciences in Nepal. MC invites submission of abstracts of research papers or abstracts of theme-based panels from eligible researchers who will have completed their research by the abstract submission deadline. Interested researchers should fill this&nbsp;google form.


Preferences


	The theme of the research should be related to Nepal; comparative work is also welcome provided that Nepal-related content is substantial.
	Young/women researchers are highly encouraged to submit the abstracts.
	&nbsp;


Abstract guidelines


	Abstracts can be in English or Nepali and should be between 400 and 500 words in length. The title of the proposed paper, a short description of the research base, and the paper’s main arguments/findings must be clearly stated.
	Abstracts for panels should consist of its title and a brief description, and the abstracts of each paper in the panel should also be included. There can be a maximum of four papers in a panel.
	Researchers can send abstracts of up to two papers as long as they are written by multiple-author teams and two separate individuals plan to present them at the conference. At the time of submission, please indicate the names of the (separate) persons who will be presenting each of the two papers.
	&nbsp;


Please note


	This is an in-person only conference. All participants, including paper presenters and panelists, are required to register to attend the conference. The registration fee is NRs. 1000/- per person.
	Participants are expected to make their own arrangements for travel and accommodation.


Important dates

Call for abstracts: February&nbsp;18, 2026
Abstract submission extended deadline:&nbsp;June 15, 2026&nbsp;
Announcement of accepted abstracts: June 30, 2026
Extended deadline for the submission of full papers (length 4000–5000 words):&nbsp;October 30, 2026
Announcement of accepted papers:&nbsp;November 6, 2026
Conference days:&nbsp;November 25–27, 2026

conference@martinchautari.org.np&nbsp;and&nbsp;mcannualconf@gmail.com&nbsp;
